about: The Collect of the feast of the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus. It gives thanks for the infinite treasures of love bestowed from the wounded Heart of the Son of God and asks for worthy reparation.

seg.tr: O God, who mercifully deignest to bestow upon us the infinite treasures of love in the Heart of Thy Son, wounded by our sins: grant, we beseech Thee, that, offering Him the devout homage of our piety, we may also fulfill the duty of worthy reparation. Through the same Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
